name: Image Replace Effect
description: Provides an image style effect capable of replacing the whole image with another one.

suggests.drupal/imagemagick: Use the ImageMagick toolkit; image_replace ships an ImageMagick replace operation (dev dependency).

project_description:
Image Replace provides a way to supply optional alternative source images mapped to image styles. This is useful when building responsive sites with art directed images where cropping and resizing is not enough but images need to be swapped out completely. For example when delivering graphics containing rendered text, e.g. responsive hero images .

 This module works well with responsive image modules leveraging image styles, for example the Picture module.

 Demo 
 
 Demo on simplytest.me . Make sure to select the Image Replace Demo installation profile. ( sandbox source )
